Website Overview and Compliance Program Management

Watch Here

July's Monthly Refresher Webinar will feature a website overview and training on compliance program management. This is an excellent webinar to attend for anyone who is currently managing an HCP compliance program and who wishes to update their website. It's also a good option for those who may have inherited responsibilities after their program was initially setup. There will be a live question and answer segment that we encourage you to participate in as well.
